{{Quote|I'm pleased I was able to ''earn'' your ''trust''... Because now I can ''complete'' the job I was sent here to do!|Silam Dunerz, to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="LT" />}}
'''Silam Dunerz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Supply Master/Legends|supply master]] in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], and held the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during the war, Dunerz was tasked with abducting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a leading figure of the enemy [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Knowing that the princess would be returning from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Morton (planet)|Morton]] aboard the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in service to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], Dunerz laid a [[Skirmish aboard the Redemption|trap]] on her route.<ref name="LT" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Silma Dunerz was created by [[Martin Fisher]] for the one-shot [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story ''[[Leia's Trust]]''.<ref name="LT" /> In Fisher's original script, Dunerz was simply referred to as a "sector commander," but editors specifically made him a supply master.<ref name="Fisher Sourcebooks">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/an-interview-with-martin-fisher-british-writer-star-wars-author/1100766206640152|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=March 19, 2016|quote=Dunerz being a supply master wasn't in my original script and I think it was added after.|archivedate=20200820184709}}</ref>
